# YTDL — YouTube Downloader

> Free, browser-based YouTube video and audio downloader. No sign-in, no limits, no uploads required. Works on Android, iPhone, and desktop.

## What it does

YTDL lets you download any YouTube video directly. Paste a URL, choose a format, and download. For HD (720p+), Smart Merge combines separate video and audio streams in your browser using WebAssembly — nothing is uploaded to a server.

## Capabilities

- Download YouTube videos in MP4 and WebM — up to 4K (2160p)
- Download audio-only tracks in M4A (AAC) and WebM (Opus)
- Smart Merge: in-browser muxing with ffmpeg.wasm, no server upload
- Shows full video metadata: views, publish date, subscriber count, duration
- Supports youtube.com, youtu.be, YouTube Shorts, and embeds
- Works on Android (Chrome), iPhone/iPad (Safari), and all desktop browsers

## Format tabs

- **Video + Audio**: Pre-muxed streams (up to 360p) + Smart Merge for HD up to 4K
- **Video Only**: Adaptive video streams up to 4K — no audio track
- **Audio Only**: All available audio streams at various bitrates

## How to use

1. Open https://youtubeone.vercel.app/
2. Paste a YouTube video URL into the input field
3. Click "Analyze & Get Formats"
4. Select a tab: Video + Audio / Video Only / Audio Only
5. Click Download (or Smart Merge for HD video with audio)

## Smart Merge (HD download)

YouTube distributes HD video (720p and above) and audio as separate DASH streams. Smart Merge:
1. Downloads the selected video stream to your browser
2. Downloads the best available audio stream to your browser
3. Uses ffmpeg.wasm (WebAssembly) to mux them into a single MP4
4. Triggers a download of the combined file

No data leaves your device except to YouTube's CDN.

## API endpoints (not public)

- POST /api/info — accepts { url: string }, returns video metadata and format list
- GET /api/stream — proxies a YouTube stream to the browser
- GET /api/ffmpeg-core — proxies ffmpeg WebAssembly core
